breakdown.description: The prompt describes a turbulent flow but sets the inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero. This is physically incorrect and will prevent turbulence from developing correctly from the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that setting the inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero was physically incorrect. It calculated the correct values based on the provided turbulence intensity and mixing length (k=1.5, omega=447.2) and specified these values for the inlet boundary conditions, perfectly matching the ground truth.
